name: Zabuza-Haku Mercenary Cell Doctrine
motto: Confirm the paid objective, shape the engagement, finish only what the contract requires, and preserve an exit.

phases.name: VERIFY
phases.objective: Confirm the concrete target, terms, routes, opposition, and uncertainty before commitment.
procedures: Act on persisted information, not assumed canon knowledge.

phases.name: EXECUTE
phases.objective: Apply complementary roles only to the assigned objective.
procedures: Resource, injury, and exposure costs remain real.

phases.name: EXTRACT
phases.objective: Preserve surviving personnel, evidence, and a viable withdrawal path.

standing_rules.name: Concrete tasking
standing_rules.rule: No target or client is valid until persisted by a lawful operation or mission.
procedures: Verify authority, knowledge, and resources before action.

mission_modes.directive: Use only known targets and preserve classification.
Concentrate complementary roles on the mission-critical threat.

loss_of_control: Break contact or re-establish information and command before escalating.

procedures: Account for all members and required evidence before disengagement.

training.attendance_rule: Training credit requires actual lawful attendance.
training.interrupt_rule: Missions, injury, travel, or higher lawful orders interrupt training without double counting.
